# Menu screen — M3 guidance

<!-- Generated by apps/site/scripts/one-off/migrate-guidance.mjs. Do not edit by hand.
     The component pages carry the reference; this file carries the guidance. -->

## Web

### Features

Reach for a menu screen when the content IS a set of grouped destinations or commands and it belongs in the page: a settings list, an admin index, a workspace switcher's alternatives. It is deliberately not a menu — it is not modal, it does not take the interaction lock and it carries no elevation token, the same docked-versus-dialog reasoning the `DockSheet` uses. The groups are the shared menu data (`MenuGroup`), the same shape the `MenuSheet` takes, so an action can live on the page today and in a sheet tomorrow without being rewritten. Groups without a heading render as one flat list; a heading makes the group a named group.

## Native

### Features

Reach for a menu screen when the grouped actions belong ON the screen rather than over it: a settings page, a per-item action list, anywhere the list is the page. It takes exactly the same `groups` data that `MenuSheet` does, so a host can move an action from a screen into a sheet without rewriting it — the two differ in presentation only, which is the whole reason the data shape is shared. The screen is a scrolling list over the surface colour, built from `MenuGroupList`, so it inherits that component's rules about headings and rows.
